intents.message: We honestly don't know which AI tools our staff are using. Get us ready for the day one of them goes wrong.
Get our next grant application drafted — whichever funder deadline comes up first; I've lost track of the calendar.
Nobody has listed the AI tools across our three sites. Set us up to respond well when one of them goes wrong.
Figure out which of our funder deadlines is next and get a first draft of that application going.
We've never taken stock of which AI tools our caseworkers use. Before anything breaks, set up how we'd respond to an AI mistake.
Our funder deadlines are scattered across three inboxes. Sort out what's due and start the application for the earliest one.
Volunteers have started using chatbots on their own and we have no list of which. Put a plan in place for when one gives a client bad advice.
After the merger nobody knows what AI systems either team runs. We need an incident response plan for them anyway.
The board wants an AI incident procedure, but we haven't catalogued our AI use yet. Do both, in that order.
I inherited a mess of funder emails with no tracker. Work out which opportunity is due first and draft the application for it.
It's grant season and we have no list of what's open. Build the list and write the first proposal on it.
I'm the new development director and there's no record of our prospects. Figure out the next deadline and start that proposal.
